HOTSAUCE_SETUP_TOKEN.description: Make up a setup password of at least 12 characters. Open your Worker's address, go to /setup and paste it to start the setup wizard. It works until setup is finished.

HOTSAUCE_MASTER_KEY.description: Make up a long random string and keep a copy somewhere safe. It encrypts the keys you paste into setup (Clerk, Anthropic, Deepgram, GitHub). Changing it later locks those keys away.

STATE.description: The R2 bucket that keeps Hotsauce's settings and keys while the server's own disk comes and goes. Each Hotsauce needs its own: choose Create new if this one belongs to another.

HOTSAUCE.description: The server, running in a Cloudflare Container.
